scope.summary: Extend the foundation StudioCommand contract (MT-007) so every command declares the capability it requires (e.g. studio.document.write, studio.export, studio.filesystem.read) and the caller's granted capability set (operator, or a plugin's manifest+consent set) gates which commands resolve. An unknown or ungranted command MUST fail closed with a typed StudioCommandError, never a silent no-op. Versioned command ids.
acceptance_criteria: every command declares required capability; granted set gates resolution; unknown/ungranted fails closed typed
proof_targets: fail-closed negative test on ungranted/unknown command
expected_tests: negative: ungranted command fails closed with typed error (no mutation, no no-op)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Automation / Command capabilities & gating (model layer)

risk_if_missed: Automation could resolve ungranted commands or silently no-op; capability gate bypassed.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
